newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Wugang fires up 1.8 mln T/yr steel plant.
newsitem.headline: China's Wugang fires up 1.8 mln T/yr steel plant.

text.p: Wuhan Iron and Steel, or Wugang, in central China has fired up a new steel refinery capable of making 1.8 million tonnes of steel products a year, the China News Service said on Monday.
The new Number Three Steel Refinery, begun in 1992, had cost 6.5 billion yuan ($783 million) and was fitted with equipment imported from Germany and Spain, the agency said.
Producing 1.8 million tonnes of thin steel sheets and steel alloys a year, the plant was part of a drive by Wugang to boost its steel output to 10 million tonnes a year, it said.
The plant covered 1.33 million square metres (13.9 million square feet), it said but gave no further details.
